newsitem.title: UK: S&P acquires Fund Research unit, terms undisclosed.
newsitem.headline: S&P acquires Fund Research unit, terms undisclosed.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had acquired Fund Research Limited, a provider of research and analysis of investment funds.
S&P did not disclose terms of the acquisition, or how many staff Fund Research employs. The new unit will be called Standard & Poor's Fund Research, S&P said in a statement.
S&P said the acquisition combined its expertise in fixed income funds and Fund Research's reputation in equity investment funds. "Fund research dramatically expands our global coverage," it said.

The unit will be headed by Peter Jeffreys, who with Richard Timberlake founded Fund Research. "Our new relationship will create new opportunities for expanded products and services to better serve our customers," Jeffreys said in the statment.
S&P said Timberlake will contineu to provide strategic direction as a consultant and Nigel Slade will remain as director of S&P Fund Research's sales and marketing.
